parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Required. Start of the reporting period (date or datetime; treated as app timezone).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Required. End of the reporting period. Must be on or after date_from.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Optional. Aggregation lens: state (one row per destination region) | in_state_out_of_state (collapses to two rows: In-State home jurisdiction vs Out-of-State) | responsibility (two rows: Seller-collected vs Marketplace facilitator) | state_responsibility (one row per state, each carrying a seller_net_tax / marketplace_net_tax split). Defaults to state.
